run_QFVS_training: run the QFVS summary transformer training on specified train and test videos via CLI
extract_video_features: extract video features for a given video ID using the extract_video_features function
extract_multimodal_features: extract multimodal features from video and question-answer pairs using Extract_Multimodal_Features class
train_summary_transformer: train the Runner_summary_transformer model on video features with specified config and bias
